description:
Answer common coverage questions for procedure codes in one workflow.
Use this when a user asks whether codes are covered, whether prior authorization is required, what policies support the answer, or how coverage differs by jurisdiction.
This tool can combine code lookup, related policy evidence, prior-auth checks (traditional Medicare, or the named payer's own policies when payer is given), claim-risk validation, jurisdiction comparison, and spending evidence so the agent does not need to chain endpoint-shaped tools.

Takes codes, payers, plan types and states only. Never send patient names, dates of birth, member IDs or other patient identifiers.

Supports optional response_format: 'markdown' (default) for readable text or 'json' for the returned structuredContent object.

code_include.description: Code detail data to include when running code_details

code_system.description: Optional code system hint for lookup, e.g. CPT or HCPCS

compare_jurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions to compare for regional coverage variation

date_of_service.description: Policy as-of date, YYYY-MM-DD: the date whose policy version applies. Used by the claim_risk module.

diagnosis_codes.description: Diagnosis codes when claim-risk validation is needed

include.description: Evidence modules to run. Defaults to code details and prior auth.

jurisdiction.description: Optional MAC jurisdiction code for policy filtering, e.g. JM or JH

payer.description: Payer name, slug or code, e.g. 'Moda Health'. The prior-auth check answers from this payer's policies, and code details list only this payer's policies. Omit it for traditional Medicare.

procedure_codes.description: CPT/HCPCS procedure codes, e.g. ['76942'] or ['J0585', '64493']. Up to 50 are supported for code_details-only batch lookup; contextual modules are limited to 10 codes.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for readable text or 'json' for machine-readable structuredContent.

state.description: Two-letter state where the service is provided, used to infer the MAC jurisdiction, e.g. TX

name: backwork_coverage_lookup

data.description: Structured data returned by the Backwork API when available.

message.description: Human-readable result, status, or empty-result message.

meta.description: Response metadata such as pagination when available.

provenance.description: Where the answer came from and how current it is. Cite source_urls when answering.

as_of.description: Latest effective date among the cited sources.

authorities.description: Issuing authorities, for example "CMS" or a payer name.

retrieved_at.description: Oldest retrieval time among the cited sources: every source was fetched at or after this time.

source_urls.description: Distinct source document URLs to cite.

widget.description: Coverage result card: the policies that list the requested codes, with each code's disposition.

grounding.description: Retained-text grounding reported by the API; null for older responses.

title: Coverage Lookup
